evidence: Codex v0.4.1 whole-plugin activation is bounded to one exact provider-native ID on Codex 0.155.1 / macOS Apple Silicon, projects only the selected captured bundle into the private shadow PluginStore, keeps sibling bundles absent, write-denies the projection, preserves clean defaults, and revalidates source/provider/projection state before provider birth.

Locked all-target CI plus focused Codex projection, source-drift, sibling, symlink, tamper, raw-control-conflict, clean-after-selected, public-identity, fuzz and CodeQL coverage exercise the affected trust boundaries.
Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock change only the package version to 0.4.1; no runtime/build dependency is added or replaced, and Dependency Review remains required.

Release candidate CI provisions exact current-stable Codex and Claude Code canaries from canonical provider pins, verifies npm latest tags and registry integrity, and binds qualification to those provisioned provider versions.

The full v0.4.0→v0.4.1 delta includes the post-v0.4.0 CycloneDX/action-time release hardening plus new Codex clean→selected→clean artifact smoke evidence, canonical provider pin freshness checks, and action-time provider revalidation before protected tag push.

README, Codex/Claude docs, limitations and changelog bind v0.4.1 claims to Codex 0.155.1 and Claude Code 2.1.278 on macOS Apple Silicon and keep MCP restore, --with=all, multi-plugin, component surgery and other platforms explicitly unqualified.

near_misses.durable_control: Codex activation requires both exact-bundle projection into the active private shadow PluginStore and session-layer exact plugin enablement; session flags alone are not treated as qualification evidence.

Shadow PluginStore selection is single-bundle only, verified by path+digest ownership marker and cache-only-selected checks; stale owned projections are reconciled, while unknown siblings or tampered projections fail closed and are preserved rather than blindly deleted.

Projection preserves executable bits while removing write bits recursively; provider sandbox also write-denies the shadow plugin cache and marker, with regression tests for read-only and executable semantics.
Provider identity/version, installed source identity/digest and projected bundle are revalidated after planning and again immediately before provider exec; any drift refuses before provider birth.
When CLROOM plugin selection is active, raw Codex config/profile/feature/plugin controls are refused before provider birth; arguments after the provider terminator remain literal.

Canonical provider-pins.sh records exact current-stable versions and npm integrity; check-provider-pins.sh verifies latest tags and integrity during candidate provisioning and again at the action-time tag boundary.
Release contract tests consume the canonical provider-pins.sh contract instead of duplicating stale provider version and digest literals.
Public identity tests include features.remote_plugin=false in the exact Codex clean argv contract while preserving native Codex process identity and passthrough semantics.
The post-v0.4.0 release delta explicitly verifies the exported SBOM attestation bundle with the CycloneDX predicate before publication.

Protected-tag helper refreshes main/tag/ruleset/release-contract/provider-pin state at action time, compares local provider version and bytes to pretag evidence, performs one tag push, then reconciles the authoritative remote result.

Release readiness provisions the pinned current Codex canary before full locked tests; negative qualification tests derive the executable's actual provider version and therefore exercise the fail-closed harness instead of returning early or failing before evidence creation.

artifact_capability_gates.requirement: Build exact accepted-main v0.4.1 archive on macOS Apple Silicon with current-stable Codex 0.155.1 and an already-installed exact Codex plugin; prove clean-before absence, selected capability presence, clean-after absence, unchanged ambient provider/plugin state and source bytes, exact provider/plugin evidence, and normal selected-plugin interactive TUI without a model prompt.

Download exact Draft Release v0.4.1 archive, verify checksums/provenance/SBOM bundles, then prove the same clean→selected→clean Codex plugin behavior and unchanged provider/plugin state against the Draft bytes.

Requalify the shipped Claude whole-plugin path on current-stable Claude Code 2.1.278 using exact accepted-main v0.4.1 bytes; prove clean absence, selected presence, no newly admitted sibling, no plugin errors, unchanged persistent provider config, and normal selected-plugin interactive TUI without a model prompt.
Re-run the Claude plugin capability smoke on exact Draft Release v0.4.1 bytes after checksum and attestation verification, bound to current-stable Claude Code 2.1.278.

product_outcome: Ship v0.4.1 as the bounded exact Codex whole-plugin selective-restore slice while preserving clean-by-default behavior, requalifying Codex and Claude Code against their current stable releases, and strengthening release drift controls without widening to standalone MCP, --with=all, multi-plugin selection, component surgery, new dependencies or additional platforms.

contract_evolution_review.rationale: v0.4.1 adds a new provider activation trust boundary and exposes fast-moving provider-version drift as a release correctness risk. Existing v0.4.0 controls remain necessary but are not sufficient for Codex shadow-PluginStore projection or daily provider updates, so deterministic artifact smoke and current-provider freshness/integrity controls are promoted.
promoted_controls: exact one-bundle Codex shadow PluginStore projection with sibling absence and write denial
action-time Codex source/provider/projection revalidation before provider birth
clean→selected→clean Codex artifact capability smoke for accepted main and Draft release bytes
canonical exact provider pins with npm latest-tag and registry-integrity checks for Codex and Claude Code
provider freshness recheck at the protected tag action boundary
release contract tests bound to canonical provider pins rather than duplicated version literals
continued CycloneDX bundle predicate verification and action-time release-state guards from the post-v0.4.0 main delta
